name: The Last Bus Home
source:
You sit at your bus stop every morning, meeting the same stranger over and over again. Do you become friends? Or do you remain strangers? 

[From [url=https://koiichiwa.itch.io/the-last-bus-home]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每天早上，你坐在公交车站，一遍又一遍地遇到同一个陌生人。你们成为朋友了吗？还是你们依然是陌生人？

[来自[url=https://koiichiwa.itch.io/the-last-bus-home]Itch.io[/url]]
